title: KR:013492:ADDENDUM:29849:20190611
full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 29849, June 11, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2019.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Development and Management of Marinas shall be amended as follows:
In Article 35 (2), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Ship Investment Company Act shall be amended as follows:
Article 15, subparagraph 1, shall be amended as follows:
1. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act and classification societies under Article 60 (2) of the Ship Safety Act.

(3) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Fishing Vessels Act shall be amended as follows:
In the part of Article 16 (3) other than the subparagraphs thereof, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority established under Article 45 of the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(4) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Fishing Grounds Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Note 3 of attached Table 1, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(5) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety shall be amended as follows:
Item 73 of attached Table 1-2 shall be amended as follows:
73. Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority.

(6) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act shall be amended as follows:
Article 106 (7) 24 shall be amended as follows:
24. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act.

(7) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Local Taxes shall be amended as follows:
In the column of institutions required to submit taxation data for item 145 of attached Table 3, "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority under the Ship Safety Act" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act".

(8) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Harbor Act shall be amended as follows:
In the part of Article 25-4 (1) other than the subparagraphs thereof and in paragraph (2) of the same Article, each reference to "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority".

(9) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Marine Environment Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 88 (1), "Korea Ship Safety Technology Authority" shall be replaced with "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority".

(10) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Conservation and Utilization of the Marine Environment shall be amended as follows:
Article 11 (2) 4 shall be amended as follows:
4. The Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority established under the Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority Act and classification societies under Article 60 (2) of the Ship Safety Act.
